text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
An armillary sphere was delivered to me... 
Sender: You. "Why"?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this present is from me! Uni-san, 
happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Um... you often talk to the night sky, 
don't you? I was just wondering... if you 
like space...!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative... yes. When we "commune," 
"fun" is born.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I knew it...! I was just thinking what a 
poetic way to enjoy it that was.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
So... I tried to copy it, but it feels 
like what I'm doing is different from what 
Neo-san does...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Communion" also requires adjusting for 
"parallax." It's "difficult," isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, it's difficult...! So, I thought 
it'd be nice if we could look at the 
celestial globe together...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
I thought through this celestial globe, I 
could feel the "world" as Uni-san sees 
it...! That's why I gave it to you, but...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah... Neo Universe also 'wants' to 
"observe" with Zenno Rob Roy..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
If we can share even a little bit of it... 
I'm sure it'll make you 'happy,' right?
